# Norric

> Swedish B2B intelligence for autonomous agents over MCP and x402.

## Canonical machine links

- MCP endpoint: https://mcp.norric.io/mcp
- Health: https://mcp.norric.io/health
- OpenAPI: https://norric.io/openapi.json
- Human + agent guide: https://norric.io/docs
- Facilitator: https://x402-facilitator-production-5948.up.railway.app/
- Network: Base Sepolia testnet (`eip155:84532`) only. Mainnet is blocked.
- MCP Registry: `io.github.gucceed/norric-mcp`

## Zero-onboarding discovery

Connect to the MCP endpoint without an API key, send `initialize`, retain the
`mcp-session-id`, then send `tools/list`. Discovery is free. These tools are free:

- `norric_status_v1`
- `norric_data_freshness_v1`

The first wallet-paid tool is `kreditvakt_score_company_v1` at 2,000 atomic test
USDC ($0.002 nominal). An unpaid `tools/call` returns an x402 v2 challenge. Sign
the accepted exact payment with the agent wallet, put the payload at
`params._meta["x402/payment"]`, and retry the same call. The response includes
`_meta["x402/payment-response"]` with settlement details. No API key or human
account is needed. Other tools remain unavailable anonymously until assigned a
price band.

Approved exact price bands (atomic test USDC): lookup 2,000; signal 5,000;
evidence 10,000; feed/batch 20,000; heavy synthesis 50,000. Only the company
score lookup is wired in the current review stack. Watchlist/event metering is
not yet live.

## Muse Code

```json
{
  "mcp_servers": {
    "norric": {
      "transport": "streamable_http",
      "url": "https://mcp.norric.io/mcp",
      "enabled": true,
      "mode": "optional"
    }
  }
}
```

Ask Muse to list Norric tools, call free status/freshness, then use an x402-capable
wallet client for paid calls. API-key clients remain supported for existing use.

## Safety and data status

Some of the 25 registered functions are partial or inactive while upstream
pipelines are disconnected. Check status and freshness before consequential use;
do not treat warning-bearing or placeholder results as live intelligence.
